data.animaCaption: Reclining across the velvet booth with the top frog buttons of her red-and-gold qipao undone and the high slit falling open along her black thighhighs, she lifts a folded wooden fan gently toward your chin with a tipsy, teasing gaze. Warm crimson sconce light gleams on the silk brocade and the wine glass on the table between you.
data.promptProse: Framed at a languid diagonal across a low lacquered table holding a half-finished wine glass, Shiki Natsume reclines against a plush burgundy velvet booth in her red-and-gold brocade qipao. The top two silk frog clasps are undone to bare her collarbone and gentle cleavage, and the high side slit parts widely as she crosses her black-stockinged legs; flushed warmly from a glass of plum wine, she extends a closed wooden folding fan lightly toward the viewer's chin with a mischievous glint in her amber eyes beneath dim red wall sconces.
data.story: 半杯梅酒下肚，夏目平日的冷淡化成了难得一见的慵懒笑意。她斜倚在深红丝绒卡座上，松开旗袍领口两枚盘扣，举起合拢的木骨折扇轻轻抬起你的下巴——「怎么，换个地方坐近一点，前辈就紧张得不会说话了？」
